messages.subject: Many missing values for adj.pvalue
parts:
Dear all,

I am struggling with the analysis of a phospho-DIA-dataset for which I would like to use MSstatsPTM.
I do have the following experimental design:

Protein data: unfractionated, DIA data run through SpectronautV17, 24 files with 12 conditions and "only" two biological replicates

PTM data: fractionated DIA data run through spectronaut, 72 files with 3 fractions, 12 conditions and "only" two biological replicates

I am able to run the MSstatsPTM workflow (until groupComparisonPTM) successfully without errors BUT I do have a lot of missing values say adjusted pValues that are NA.
This is especially true for the adjusted model!

My question: Is this expected when you try to use MSstatsPTM with only 2 biological replicates?

Do I use it wrong? (I have to say that I am not using the SpectronauttoMSstatsFormat function here but reshape the data frames on my own.

Best regards
jonas

////
> # how many NAs in total
> table(is.na(MSstatsPTM.model$PROTEIN.Model$adj.pvalue))

FALSE  TRUE
68046  2478
> table(is.na(MSstatsPTM.model$PTM.Model$adj.pvalue))

 FALSE   TRUE
 36368 149212
> table(is.na(MSstatsPTM.model$ADJUSTED.Model$adj.pvalue))

 FALSE   TRUE
  1159 184421
